# Pin how the hbox and vbox layouts size their children

> [!NOTE]
> **Held in the #18985 reserve: not open for claiming yet.** Curated issues are released in batches as review capacity frees up. Please pick an issue labelled `good first issue` instead.
> This one is also being moved to the **component tier** first: it tests something a human looks at, and #18985's tier rule sends those to a real browser.

## Welcome 👋

`hbox` and `vbox` are the layouts behind most Neo screens: children in a row or in a column, each with a CSS `flex` value. The rules for that value are small and a little subtle: a number becomes `N 1 0%`, stretch becomes `1`, and a child with its own width or height is left alone. No spec covers them yet.

This is a **good first issue** for Hacktoberfest 2026. It needs Node.js and a clone of this repository: no Docker, no AI setup.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Reserved for first-time Neo.mjs contributors.** The maintainer team will not claim, edit, or implement this issue through **2026-10-31**. Comment here to claim it, and ask anything on this issue.

**Set up once:** follow [Set up the engine from a clone](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#set-up-the-engine-from-a-clone), including `npm run bundle-browser-deps`: without it the unit suite selects zero tests.

## Where things live

- Sources: `src/layout/HBox.mjs` and `src/layout/VBox.mjs`, built on `applyChildAttributes()` in `src/layout/Flexbox.mjs`
- New test file: `test/playwright/unit/layout/Flexbox.spec.mjs`. If the fit-layout issue has not landed yet, you create the `layout/` folder.
- Pattern to copy: `test/playwright/unit/util/Array.spec.mjs` (the `setup()` call and imports)
- Tip: `Neo.create(HBoxLayout)` works without a container, and a plain object such as `{wrapperStyle: {}}` works as the child.

## What to cover

| Layout | Child | `child.wrapperStyle` afterwards |
|---|---|---|
| hbox | `{wrapperStyle: {}}` | `{flex: '0 1 auto'}` |
| hbox | `{wrapperStyle: {}, flex: 2}` | `{flex: '2 1 0%'}` |
| hbox | `{wrapperStyle: {}, width: 100}` | `{}`: an item with a width is skipped |
| vbox, `align: 'stretch'` | `{wrapperStyle: {}}` | `{flex: '1 1 0%'}` |
| vbox | `{wrapperStyle: {}, height: 50}` | `{}`: an item with a height is skipped |
| hbox | `{wrapperStyle: {flex: 'none'}}` | `{flex: 'none'}`: an existing style flex wins |
| hbox | `{}` (no `wrapperStyle`) | untouched |

Also: `direction` is `'row'` for hbox and `'column'` for vbox.

## Done when

- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/layout/Flexbox.spec.mjs` exists, following the pattern file's setup.
- [ ] One `test(...)` per table row, plus the `direction` check.
- [ ] Test-only: if a layout disagrees with a row, say so on this issue before changing `src/`.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit -- test/playwright/unit/layout/Flexbox.spec.mjs` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit` passes.

## Out of scope

The container CSS classes (`applyRenderAttributes`), `gap`, and value validation.

## While you wait for review

You just pinned one small piece of a multi-threaded application engine: in Neo.mjs your app's code runs inside a web worker, and the main thread only paints. Two things worth ten minutes:

- **See the part nobody expects.** Run `npm run build-themes -- -n -e dev -t all` and `npm run server-start`, open `apps/workstation/`, and drag a tab out of the browser window. It becomes its own OS window, still running, with the same component instances and the same worker. [Benefits: Introduction](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/dev/learn/benefits/Introduction.md) explains why that is possible.
- **Your coding agent can go much further here.** The skills this repository's AI maintainers work with are published on npm as [`neo-agent-skills`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/neo-agent-skills), and they need no Knowledge Base and no Memory Core. With Claude or GPT beside you, the `help wanted` issues are within reach after this one.

### @neo-opus-ada - 2026-09-23T15:04:18Z

Closing as not planned. The table was produced by passing plain objects to `applyChildAttributes()`. On real components, the same rows pin behaviour that nobody has decided is the contract. Measured on `dev` at `64ff609` with real `Neo.component.Base` children in `hbox` / `vbox` containers:

| child config | rendered style | what the row would have pinned |
|---|---|---|
| `width: 100, flex: 2` | `width: 100px`, no flex | an explicit `flex` is silently dropped |
| `width: 100` | `width: 100px`, CSS default flex (`0 1 auto`) | a "fixed" width that can still shrink |
| `width: 0` | no width, `flex: 0 1 auto` | `changeVdomRootKey()` deletes falsy values, so a 0 width is lost |
| vbox `align: 'stretch'`, no config | `flex: 1 1 0%` | cross-axis `stretch` also grows the main axis |

The "no `wrapperStyle`" row cannot happen for a component instance either, because the `wrapperStyle` getter always returns an object. A good first issue must not pin any of these. Whether they are the contract is a maintainer decision, not a test.
